proper_distance.label: $t$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$) of the confining flow, each point in the diagram a single event, with the cones closing toward the singularity $r = 0$ and opening toward the boundary as $\sqrt{e^{2r/L} - 1}$.

bfs_u.label: $t$ and $u$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $u$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$) of the confining flow, each point in the diagram a single event, with light rays $du/d(ct) = \pm 2\sqrt{u(1 - u)}/L$ and the cones closing at the singularity $u = 0$ and at the boundary $u = 1$.

coulomb_disc.label: $t$ and $v$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $v$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$) of the disc of branes ($\ell = 3L/2$), each point in the diagram a single event, with light rays $dv/d(ct) = \pm 2\ell v\sqrt{1 - v}/L^2$ and the cones closing toward the singularity $v = 0$, which light reaches only as $t \to \pm\infty$.
